title: A bounded reflection compression sharpens the non-KMS Hardy projection fraction

statement.quantifiers: Every 0<r<1, finite positive nodes R_i and arbitrary complex coefficients v_i; U(u)=sum v_i/(R_i^2+u^2), b_r(z)=z^(1.5-r)/(1+z), V(u)=sum v_i b_r(R_i)/(R_i^2+u^2).
statement.assertion: ||b_r(iu)U||^2 >= ||V||^2/(1+|cos(pi r)|), yielding the exact lower power-kernel coefficient sin(pi r)/(1+|cos(pi r)|).
assumptions: Finite rational spans with L2 boundary values; b_r is not asserted globally bounded.
Pole cancellation and even V; right-half-plane Hardy projections.

inputs: Verified fractional Loewner physical kernel and finite pole field.
outputs: A sharp kernel lower fraction; physical universal sharpness supplied separately.
interface.precision: Exact boundary/operator identities at each fixed finite p.
costs: No infinite plane wave or p/scale limit interchange.
Physical upper constructions and conditioning are separate.

proof_mechanism: Cancel poles to obtain P_-[b_r U]=P_-V and ||V||^2=2||P_-V||^2.
J0=M_(b_r(iu)/b_r(-iu)) times reflection is a self-adjoint unitary fixing F=b_r U.
Inner Theta=(1-z)/(1+z) makes the cosine compression vanish; remaining norm <=|cos(pi r)|.
Projection (I+J0)/2 and Cauchy-Schwarz give the improved fraction.
Undo signed and positive congruences in the exact fractional Loewner representation.
obstructions: Non-KMS same-generator conjugate-p duality is false; use the Petz-reversed generator.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Find the exact physical integral and an invariant reflection, then control its Hardy compression rather than guess a scalar prefactor.

review.source_reported: Source reports internally reconstructed and adversarially audited mathematics with scoped finite checks; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
